articles.title: Record number of purges as Xi emphasises 'party discipline' at China political gathering

events.summary: Xi Jinping emphasized party discipline at a Chinese political gathering amid a record number of purges. Observers characterize the anti-corruption drive as an effort to consolidate authority.
events.why: A record-level purge in the Chinese Communist Party reshapes the leadership structure and governance of the world's second-largest economy.

articles.title: El Salvador sends 2,000 troops to Haiti to rescue four missing soldiers

events.summary: El Salvador deployed 2,000 troops to Haiti to find four soldiers who went missing during an ambush near Port-au-Prince. The missing personnel disappeared on the capital's outskirts.
events.why: A significant foreign military deployment of 2,000 troops marks a major escalation in international intervention in Haiti's security crisis.

articles.title: US sanctions Rwanda's defence ministry over DR Congo conflict

events.summary: The United States imposed sanctions on Rwanda's defence ministry over the conflict in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Congo claims Rwanda supports M23 rebels and extracts minerals in its eastern region.
events.why: US sanctions on a national defense ministry escalate diplomatic pressure and influence an ongoing regional conflict involving armed groups and resource extraction.

articles.title: Details of thousands of US immigration agents leaked in major hack

events.summary: A hacking group called the Department of Peace leaked information belonging to more than 41,000 Department of Homeland Security staff. The breach affected thousands of US immigration agents.
events.why: Doxxing tens of thousands of federal law enforcement agents poses direct security risks to personnel and sensitive immigration operations.

articles.title: Venezuela’s Machado lauds Trump for ‘freedom’, urges 2027 elections

events.summary: Venezuelan opposition figure Machado returned from exile to call for elections in 2027 and criticized a US oil agreement with Caracas. She also commended Donald Trump regarding freedom.
events.why: The return of a prominent opposition leader to Venezuela directly influences the country's political trajectory and international oil agreements.

articles.title: Young athlete and former minister among victims of Spain train crash

events.summary: A fatal train crash in Spain resulted in widespread grief and anger as victim identities were released. Among the casualties were a former government minister and a young athlete.
events.why: A deadly mass transit disaster involving public figures carries transport safety implications and significant national impact.

articles.title: Rock collapse kills two in Turkey's Cappadocia, local media reports

events.summary: A rock formation known as a "fairy chimney" collapsed outside an open-air museum in Cappadocia, Turkey. The incident resulted in the deaths of two people.
events.why: It reports a fatal geological collapse at a major tourist site.
